item.title: [infoq] 刚刚，Gemini 4 Argon 发布：多项基测碾压 GPT-6 Astra，已参与谷歌 80 万行内核代码迁移
item.description: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, aimed at long-horizon software engineering, legal and financial enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, with CEO Sundar Pichai unveiling it on X. The output cap rises from 64K to 1M tokens, and it is first available to vetted cyber-defense teams through the Fairwind program. Google reports 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 and first place on Zapier's AutomationBench at 51.3%.

item.title: [infoq] 首发！openJiuwen workSwarm全双工多模态 ，像聊天一样与Agent交互，昇腾算力原生亲和
item.description: openJiuwen, an open-source AI agent platform, has released WorkSwarm, an office and coding workbench that runs real-time audio/video interaction and a background Core Agent inside the same task. Users can interrupt the agent mid-speech or hand off slower work such as research and document generation to the Core Agent. Built by Huawei's 2012 Lab and other teams, it ships one-click installers for Windows, Mac and HarmonyOS.

item.title: [infoq] 谷歌开源面向自主 AI 代理的 Kubernetes 风格编排器 AX
item.description: Google open-sourced AX (hosted at agentexecutor.io and GitHub google/ax) under Apache 2.0, an orchestrator that runs autonomous agents as stateful actors on Agent Substrate with sub-second suspend and resume and no cold starts. Its control plane defines four declarative primitives — Task, Workspace, Gateway and Model — under ax.io/v1alpha1, driven by a Go-based ax CLI, with the control plane deployed to Kubernetes via ko and Redis in the ax-system namespace.

item.description: QCon Shanghai 2026 runs 22–24 October, themed around engineering practice for the Harness AI era, with tracks on AI Native architecture, Agent Runtime, AI Infra and more. Zheng Zhong, solutions lead at Shengshu Technology, will speak in the AIGC content industrialization track about Vidu's multimodal model, covering character and scene consistency, reference-driven generation, streaming video generation and world models. He previously led solutions teams at ByteDance and Baidu AI Cloud.

item.title: [infoq] 从 AI 试点到营收增长：Snowflake 销售与营销团队如何跨越落地鸿沟 ｜ 技术实践
item.description: Snowflake has published The GTM Leader's Blueprint for AI Transformation, documenting how its own sales and marketing teams apply AI across the customer lifecycle to drive revenue. Its main finding is that the bottleneck is organizational rather than technical: the two functions optimize different goals and rely on different data, so AI only makes the split more visible. Shared data and redesigned cross-team workflows are needed before local productivity gains turn into pipeline.

Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

item.title: [github_trending] mattpocock/skills
item.description: Matt Pocock open-sourced his personal AI agent skills in mattpocock/skills, taken from his own .agents directory and used for real engineering, not vibe coding. Unlike frameworks like GSD, BMAD, or Spec-Kit that own the whole process, these skills are deliberately small, adaptable, composable, and model-agnostic, giving developers more control. He encourages hacking on them and making them your own.

item.title: [github_trending] pbakaus/impeccable
item.description: Impeccable is a design guidance package for AI coding agents, shipping one skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 61 deterministic detector rules; install it with npx impeccable install, then run /impeccable init to record product facts in PRODUCT.md. It builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill and targets AI-generated clichés such as Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients and cards nested in cards.

item.description: Clef and Clef-flash are open-weight decision models hosted on Workers AI, targeting high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Alongside them, a new reinforcement learning platform lets developers fine-tune decision models on their own data. Teams building fast classification or agent pipelines get an openly weighted, tunable option.

item.title: [github_trending] obra/superpowers
item.description: obra/superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built on composable skills plus initial instructions your agent is meant to follow. Its README documents setup for many coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI. It targets developers who want their coding agent to follow a repeatable engineering process instead of improvising.
